properties.Incident_Description: THE CALLER IS REPORTING AN EXPLOSION THAT CAUSED A TRACTOR TRAILER FIRE.  THE CALLER STATES THAT THERE WAS A DOUBLE LOAD TRACTOR TRAILER BEING TRANSPORTED, WHEN THERE WAS AN EXPLOSION THAT BLEW THE DOOR OPEN ON THE BACK OF THE SECOND (HAZMAT) TRAILER THAT CONTAINED TRIETHYLENE TETRAMINE (AMINES), POLYAMINES, DIETHYLENETRIAMINE TETRAMINE, (PHENOL, DIETHYLENETRIAMINE). THE EXPLOSION CAUSED A FIRE TO ERUPT ON THE SECOND TRAILER, THAT LEAD INTO THE FIRST TRAILER.  THE FIRST TRAILER CONTAINED UNKNOWN NON-HAZARDOUS MATERIAL AND THE SECOND TRAILER CONTAINED 4 CORROSIVE HAZARDOUS MATERIALS, AND LITHIUM BATTERIES. THE DRIVER WAS ABLE TO DETACH THE TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK BEFORE THE TRAILERS CAUGHT FIRE.  THE CALLER STATES THAT THE FIRE DEPARTMENT, POLICE DEPARTMENT AND TEXAS STATE TROOPERS HAVE CLOSED THE ROAD AND PLAN TO EXTINGUISH THE FIRE WITH UNKNOWN  FIRE FIGHTING FOAM. THE CALLER ALSO STATES, THAT EITHER THE COUNTY OR THE STATE HAS ARRIVED WITH A "FRONT END LOADER" (CONSTRUCTION VEHICLE) AND PUSHED THE RESIDUAL BURNT MATERIAL INTO THE ROAD SIDE DITCH, WHILE THERE WERE TOW TRUCKS ON SCENE TO REMOVE THE BURNT TRAILERS.  PERSONNEL FROM THE SRP ARE ENROUTE TO PICK UP THE DRIVER,  AND WILL HAVE A SECOND DRIVER WITH THEM TO DRIVE THE TRACTOR TAILER TRUCK BACK TO THE FACILITY. IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE DRIVER WILL BE EVALUATED AT THIS TIME.
